## Forms · Save Task Draft → `n8n_saveTaskDraft(actor, taskId, notes, checklist)`
Saves partial progress on an action item **without closing it** (same as the UI's *Save draft*). `checklist` = `{ "<item text>": { "status": "Pending|Complete|Collected|…", "comments": "…" } }` — stored in the UI's `{items:{…}}` shape with `by` = actor and `at` = now. Items you omit are left untouched.
Use it from multi-step automations (e.g. SiteDocs done, DSS pending) and finish with *Forms · Close Task* once everything is done. `E_TASK_NOT_OPEN` if the task was Cancelled. **Authorization ≠ attribution:** role checks run against the real Execution API session (`efx-bot@team-group.com`); `actor` is recorded for attribution only.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
